import unittest
from sync.rwlock import ReadWriteLock

class TestRWLock(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_rw(self):
        rw = ReadWriteLock()
        rw.acquire_read()
        rw.acquire_read()
        rw.release_read()
        rw.release_read()
        rw.acquire_write()
        rw.release_write()

if __name__ == '__main__': unittest.main()
